whisperDistance.Name: Whisper Distance
whisperDistance.Hint: Distance (in scene grid units) within which whisper-tier messages are heard.

proximityDistance.Name: Talk Distance
proximityDistance.Hint: Distance (in scene grid units) within which normal talk messages are heard.

screamDistance.Name: Shout Distance
screamDistance.Hint: Distance (in scene grid units) within which shouts and /scream messages are heard.

requireVisibility.Name: Require Token Visibility
requireVisibility.Hint: If enabled, messages from tokens the player cannot see are hidden even when in range.

wallsBlockSpeech.Name: Walls Block Speech
wallsBlockSpeech.Hint: Whispers and talk are not heard through walls or closed doors. Windows and open doors let speech through. Shouts are only limited by distance.

rollMessageDistance.Name: Roll Message Distance
rollMessageDistance.Hint: Rolls and item cards (attacks, damage, saves, spells) are visible within this distance of where they happened, regardless of voice tier and walls. Messages from other scenes are hidden. 0 = off (rolls follow the speaker's voice tier, as before).

useConditions.Name: Deafened and Silenced
useConditions.Hint: A deafened character does not hear in-character speech (emotes stay visible); a silenced character cannot speak in character (OOC and emotes still work). Uses the "deafened" and "silenced" status effects.

rememberHeard.Name: Remember What Was Heard
rememberHeard.Hint: Each player's browser remembers whether they heard a message when it arrived. Without this, after a refresh or when scrolling up, visibility is recalculated from current positions: conversations you heard disappear once you walk away.

showListeners.Name: Show Who Hears a Whisper
showListeners.Hint: With the whisper tier selected, the player characters in whisper range are listed next to the voice button.

screamBubbleDuration.Name: Shout Bubble Duration (seconds)
screamBubbleDuration.Hint: How long shout bubbles stay on screen. 0 = calculated from the text like other bubbles.

minBubbleDuration.Name: Minimum Bubble Duration (seconds)
minBubbleDuration.Hint: Minimum time every chat bubble stays on screen, so short messages do not vanish instantly. 0 = no minimum.

bubbleFont.Name: Bubble Font
bubbleFont.Hint: Chat bubble font. 'Signika' (or empty) = Foundry default, fully compatible with Polyglot. Type another font name to use it (e.g. 'Cinzel', loaded from Google Fonts). System fonts such as Georgia work directly.

bubbleColor.Name: Bubble Text Colour
bubbleColor.Hint: Text colour of chat bubbles (also replaces the hard-to-read yellow /me colour). Pick a colour or type a hex value.

styleEmotes.Name: Restyle Emotes
styleEmotes.Hint: /me bubbles become frameless floating italic text above the token, and /me messages in the chat log get a darker style.

Listeners.Tooltip: Player characters who will hear your whisper: {names}
Listeners.TooltipNobody: No player character within whisper range

Notify.Deafened: Someone nearby is speaking, but you are deafened and cannot hear them.
Notify.Silenced: {name} is silenced and cannot speak. (OOC and emotes still work.)
